paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De

annotations.annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 7, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The y-axis depicts BLEU scores using a linear scale, ranging from 12 to 28, with tick labels in increments of 2. The plot includes four distinct lines. The line corresponding to "Consistency-CE" is displayed in purple with circle markers and a dashed line style, showing an increase from a BLEU score of approximately 13 at AL 0 to around 26 at AL 7. "Inconsistency-CE" is shown in dark purple with square markers and a solid line style, starting at a BLEU score of about 20 at AL 1, rising to approximately 27 at AL 7. "Inconsistency-CE-MP," represented by a blue line with square markers and a dashed line style, begins at a BLEU score of approximately 20 at AL 1, reaching about 27 at AL 7, closely following the dark purple line. Lastly, the "Consistency-Bi" line is red with star markers and a solid line style, increasing steadily from approximately 24 at AL 0 to around 27.5 at AL 7. A legend is available on the bottom right of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
